description: Dog Care teaches responsible dog ownership: breeds and history, how a dog’s body works, feeding, grooming and training, keeping a care log, preventive health and first aid, local dog laws, and careers working with dogs.

safety.note: Approach unfamiliar dogs only with the owner’s permission; dog bites need prompt first aid and medical attention.

outlineNote: Excerpts showed the topics (history and breeds, body parts, training and responsibilities, a two-month care log, health, first aid, a veterinarian or shelter visit, dog laws, and careers or hobbies) but not their numbering, so no requirement outline is published yet.
